summary: Paul Scanlon, 67, of Arvada drowned at Eleven Mile Reservoir when his kayak flipped in high winds ~3:30 p.m.; CPW officers pulled him out and performed CPR for over an hour; declared deceased ~4:30 p.m.; ill-fitting life jacket covered his face, contributing.
location: Eleven Mile Reservoir, Eleven Mile State Park
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Hartsel Fire Department; South Park Ambulance; Flight for Life
notes: Run 864: CPW release (parent-opened) + People writeup (parent-opened); identity via Park County Coroner's Office. Chunk: The Flume.
